title: Volcanoes of the world (streak)
intro: 10 volcanoes of the world, one after another. Three markers too far from the place end the run, so aim with care. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Pico Basilé
rounds.fact: Pico Basilé is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 3,011 m in the source data. The data places it in Equatorial Guinea.
